description: Resident repair layer for DeepSeek Harness that detects fused tool calls and splits glued JSON objects at top-level boundaries.
plugin_description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that intercepts stream errors caused by fused tool calls, splits glued top-level JSON objects, and re-throws unprovable buffers.
core_description: Pure tool-call splitting and repair engine for DeepSeek Harness. Guarantees that unproven buffers are never emitted and original failures are re-thrown unchanged.
release_blurb:
### 0.3.0

Release 0.3.0 of dsh-remedy. Patches P-0001 and P-0002 are verified on a real host. Patch P-0003 is `tested` with negative controls (a live host writes the eight counters but only as zeros on a clean repair). The counter line now carries eight names while the four verdict words are unchanged.

Live evidence: [data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json)
social_preview: Diagram showing dsh-remedy intercepting fused tool calls in DeepSeek Harness and splitting glued JSON objects into discrete invocations.
